# main_daily_driver { #wass2s.main_daily_driver }

```python
main_daily_driver(
    dir_save,
    target_date_str,
    n_days=30,
    variables_list=None,
    stat=None,
    clim_start=None,
    clim_end=None,
    precip_source='era5',
    agera5_version='2_0',
)
```

Run daily diagnostics, optionally sourcing precipitation from AgERA5.

NOAA ERSSTv6 is a monthly product and is therefore available through
:func:`main_driver`, not through this daily pipeline. Daily SST remains
sourced from ERA5.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> main_daily_driver(
...     "./data", "2026-07-14", n_days=30,
...     variables_list=["precip"], stat="ratio",
...     clim_start=1991, clim_end=2020, precip_source="agera5",
... )
```
